app.name: TrustIoT
app.error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
app.error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again later.
error.invalid_request: The request could not be understood.
error.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do this.
error.quota_exceeded: Your plan's limit has been reached.
error.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
error.conflict: This was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again later.
error.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.timeout: The server took too long to respond. Try again.
security.cross_site_request: This request came from another site and was blocked. Open TrustIoT directly and try again.
tenant.name_invalid: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
tenant.state_invalid: Choose to suspend or resume the organization.
tenant.suspension_reason_invalid: Choose a reason to suspend (security or abuse, non-payment, contract terminated); resuming takes no reason.
tenant.state_final: This organization's contract was terminated or it was deleted, so it can't be resumed or changed.
telemetry.query_invalid: The history query is missing a setting or has one in the wrong format.
telemetry.device_id_invalid: This device ID is not valid.
telemetry.range_invalid: Check the time range: the start must be before the end, and the range can't be this long.
telemetry.point_invalid: This data point name is not valid.
telemetry.period_invalid: Choose a valid period, such as today, this week or the last 7 days.
telemetry.too_many_points: There is too much data to show at once; at most {max} can be shown. Narrow the query and try again.
telemetry.outside_queryable_period: Data from this period can no longer be queried. Choose a more recent time range.
telemetry.query_too_heavy: This query needs too many resources. Choose a shorter time range or a longer interval.
telemetry.account_not_ready: Telemetry history for this organization isn't ready yet. Try again in a few minutes.
device_model.body_too_large: The device model is too large. The limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
device_model.name_taken: Your organization already has a device model with this name.
device_model.revision_mismatch: Someone else changed this device model (it is now at revision {current}). Reload it and make your changes again.
device_model.in_use: Devices still use this device model, so it can't be deleted.
device_model.tenant_not_ready: Your organization is still being set up. Try again in a moment.
device_model.body_invalid: The device model must be a JSON object.
device_model.name_invalid: Use 1 to {max} lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter, with single hyphens between groups.
device_model.name_immutable: A device model's name can't be changed after it is created.
device_model.revision_invalid: The revision must be a positive whole number.
device_model.points_invalid: Data points must be a list.
device_model.too_many_points: A device model can have at most {max} data points.
device_model.point_key_invalid: Use 1 to {max} ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
device_model.point_key_duplicate: Another data point in this device model already uses this key.
device_model.function_code_invalid: Choose a read function code from {min} to {max}.
device_model.address_invalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
device_model.address_out_of_range: This data point's registers run past the last address.
device_model.points_overlap: This data point reads addresses that an earlier data point with the same function code already reads.
device_model.function_type_mismatch: Coils and discrete inputs (function codes 1 and 2) can only be bool.
device_model.byte_order_unexpected: This data point can't use this byte order: single bits have none, and strings use only abcd or badc.
device_model.length_invalid: Enter a length of {min} to {max} registers.
device_model.length_required: A string data point needs a length.
device_model.length_unexpected: Only string data points have a length.
device_model.scaling_invalid: Scale and offset must be finite numbers, and the scale can't be 0. Bool and string data points can't be scaled.
device_model.description_invalid: Enter a description of 1 to {max} characters. Apart from line breaks and tabs, control and invisible formatting characters aren't allowed.
device_model.format_unsupported: This file isn't a device model exported from TrustIoT.
device_model.format_version_unsupported: This device model file's format version isn't supported.
device.body_too_large: The device is too large. The limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
device.body_invalid: The device must be a JSON object.
device.name_invalid: Use 1 to {max} lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter, with single hyphens between groups.
device.name_taken: Your organization already has a device with this name.
device.name_immutable: A device can't be renamed after it is created.
device.hardware_id_invalid: Use 1 to {max} ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
device.gateway_not_bound: This gateway isn't bound to your organization.
device.gateway_immutable: A device can't move to another gateway after it is created.
device.model_not_found: Your organization has no such device model.
device.model_immutable: A device's model can't change after it is created.
device.transport_invalid: Choose Modbus TCP or RTU over TCP.
device.transport_mismatch: Another device on this gateway reaches the same host and port with the other transport. Devices behind one converter must use the same transport.
device.host_invalid: Enter an IP address or a domain name of at most {max} bytes. It can't be the gateway itself (loopback or localhost).
device.port_invalid: Use a whole number from {min} to {max}.
device.unit_id_invalid: Use a unit ID from {min} to {max}.
device.unit_taken: Another device on this gateway already uses this unit ID at the same host and port.
device.poll_interval_invalid: Use a poll interval from {min} to {max} milliseconds.
device.revision_invalid: The revision must be a positive whole number.
device.revision_mismatch: Someone else changed this device (it is now at revision {current}). Reload it and make your changes again.
device.binding_ended: The gateway this device belongs to was unbound, so the device can't be changed. You can only delete it.
workstation_certificate.body_too_large: The request is too large. The limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
workstation_certificate.body_invalid: The request must be a JSON object.
workstation_certificate.unknown_field: This field isn't recognized. The certificate authority decides the subject, the extensions and the validity.
workstation_certificate.name_invalid: Use 1 to {max} ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
workstation_certificate.request_invalid: Paste one certificate signing request in PEM format (BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST) of at most {max_bytes} bytes.
workstation_certificate.request_unsuppor: The certificate signing request must be for an ECDSA P-256 key and signed with SHA-256.
workstation_certificate.request_signatur: The certificate signing request's signature doesn't match its key. Create the request again on the workstation.
workstation_certificate.reason_invalid: Choose one of the listed revocation reasons.
workstation_certificate.ca_not_ready: The certificate authority can't issue certificates yet. Try again in a few minutes.
gateway_registration.body_too_large: The request is too large. The limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
gateway_registration.body_invalid: The request must be a JSON object.
gateway_registration.unknown_field: This field isn't recognized. The certificate authority decides the subject, the extensions and the validity.
gateway_registration.hardware_id_invalid: Use 1 to {max} ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
gateway_registration.request_invalid: Send one certificate signing request in PEM format (BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST) of at most {max_bytes} bytes.
gateway_registration.request_unsupported: The certificate signing request must be for an ECDSA P-256 key and signed with SHA-256.
gateway_registration.request_signature_i: The certificate signing request's signature doesn't match its key. Create the request again on the gateway.
gateway_registration.endorsement_key_inv: Send one public key in PEM format (BEGIN PUBLIC KEY) of at most {max_bytes} bytes.
gateway_registration.endorsement_key_uns: The endorsement key must be RSA with 2048, 3072 or 4096 bits, or ECDSA P-256 or P-384.
gateway_registration.workstation_refused: This request didn't come from a trusted production workstation. Check the workstation's certificate and clock, then try again.
gateway_registration.public_key_mismatch: This hardware ID is already registered with another key. A gateway keeps the key it was registered with.
gateway_registration.endorsement_key_mis: This hardware ID is already registered with another endorsement key.
gateway_registration.decommissioned: This hardware ID was decommissioned and cannot be registered.
gateway_registration.public_key_in_use: Another gateway is already registered with this key.
gateway_registration.endorsement_key_in_: Another active gateway is already registered with this endorsement key.
gateway_registration.ca_not_ready: The certificate authority can't register gateways yet. Try again in a few minutes.
gateway_revocation.body_too_large: The request is too large. The limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
gateway_revocation.body_invalid: The request must be a JSON object.
gateway_revocation.unknown_field: This field isn't recognized. A revocation takes only a reason.
gateway_revocation.reason_invalid: Choose one of the listed revocation reasons.
gateway_revocation.no_valid_certificate: This gateway has no valid certificate left to revoke.
gateway_binding.body_too_large: The request is too large. The limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
gateway_binding.body_invalid: The request must be a JSON object.
gateway_binding.unknown_field: This field isn't recognized. Only the tenant is set here.
gateway_binding.tenant_unknown: This tenant doesn't exist, or it was created a moment ago and isn't ready yet. Check the tenant or try again in a moment.
gateway_binding.bound_to_another_tenant: This gateway is bound to another tenant. Unbind it first.
certificate_renewal.body_too_large: The request is too large. The limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
certificate_renewal.body_invalid: The request must be a JSON object.
certificate_renewal.step_invalid: The step must be challenge or renew.
certificate_renewal.hardware_id_invalid: Use up to 64 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
certificate_renewal.nonce_invalid: Send the nonce exactly as the challenge had it.
certificate_renewal.signature_malformed: Send the DER signature in standard base64 with padding, at most 72 bytes.
certificate_renewal.challenge_unknown: This challenge doesn't exist or was already used. Ask for a new challenge.
certificate_renewal.challenge_mismatch: This challenge was issued for another gateway or another purpose. Ask for a new challenge.
certificate_renewal.challenge_expired: This challenge expired. Ask for a new challenge.
certificate_renewal.signature_refused: The signature doesn't match this gateway's registered key.
certificate_renewal.decommissioned: This gateway was decommissioned and can't renew its certificate.
certificate_renewal.key_compromised: This gateway's key was reported compromised, so it can't renew its certificate. Replace the gateway and register the new one.
certificate_renewal.not_bound: This gateway isn't bound to a tenant, so it can't renew its certificate.
certificate_renewal.bindings_stale: The certificate authority's gateway bindings may be out of date. Try again later.
certificate_renewal.ca_not_ready: The certificate authority can't renew certificates yet. Try again in a few minutes.
conversation.body_invalid: The request must be a JSON object with only the fields this action takes.
conversation.update_empty: Nothing to change. Send a new title or the archive setting.

conversation.limit_invalid: Ask for 1 to {max} conversations at a time.

conversation.question_running: A question in this conversation is still being answered. Wait for the answer, then delete the conversation.
conversation.start_limited: You have started {max} conversations in the last 24 hours. Continue one of them, or start a new one later.

user_menu.label: Account menu
tenant_gate.choose.title: Choose an organization
tenant_gate.choose.body: Your account belongs to several organizations. Choose the one to work in; you can switch at any time from the top bar.
tenant_gate.none.title: No organization yet
tenant_gate.none.body: Your account isn't a member of any organization yet, so there is nothing to show. Ask an administrator of your organization to add you, then check again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your personal settings. They apply in every organization you work in.
settings.preferences.title: Preferences
settings.preferences.description: Saved to your account, so every browser and device you sign in on uses them.
settings.ai_language.description: The language the AI assistant writes its answers in.
settings.time_zone.description: Dates and times are shown in this time zone.
settings.load_failed: Your saved preferences couldn't be loaded, so they can't be changed right now.
settings.account.title: Account
settings.sessions.title: Signed-in devices
settings.sessions.description: Sign out of TrustIoT on every device and browser, this one included. Do this if you lost a device or signed in on a computer you don't control.
settings.sessions.confirm_body: You'll be signed out here and on every other device and browser. To sign in again on any of them, you'll need a new code from your email.
settings.sessions.unfinished: Your other devices aren't signed out yet. Choose Sign out of all devices again.
page.home.title: Home
page.login.title: Sign in to TrustIoT
page.login.email_intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a sign-in code.
page.login.code_intro: If {email} has a TrustIoT account, we've sent it a {length}-digit code. The code expires in {minutes} minutes.
page.login.code_hint: Enter the {length} digits from the email.
page.login.code_rejected: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the email, or send a new code.
page.login.resend_in: Send a new code in {seconds} s
page.login.resent: We sent a new code to {email}.
page.login.signed_out_everywhere: You signed out on all your devices.
page.login.sign_out_everywhere_unfinishe: Your other devices aren't signed out yet: this session had already ended, so signing out of all devices didn't go through. Sign in, then choose Sign out of all devices again.
page.login.cookie_missing: You signed in, but this browser didn't keep the sign-in. Allow cookies for this site and try again.
page.not_found.title: Page not found
page.not_found.body: The page {path} doesn't exist or has moved.
page.forbidden.title: No permission
page.forbidden.body: Your role doesn't allow access to this page. Ask an administrator of your organization.
page.tenant_suspended.title: Organization suspended
page.tenant_suspended.body: This organization has been suspended. Contact your administrator.
page.tenant_suspended.named_body: {name} has been suspended, so its data and devices can't be used right now. Contact your organization's administrator.
page.tenant_suspended.other_tenants: You can continue in another organization:
page.unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
page.unavailable.body: TrustIoT can't be reached right now. This is usually brief.
page.error.title: Something went wrong
page.error.body: The page could not be shown.
device.not_found.title: Device not found
device.not_found.body: {tenant} has no device with this address. It may have been removed, or it belongs to another organization: switch organizations in the top bar to look there.
device.model_failed: The device's model couldn't be loaded, so data points are listed by key only: {reason}
device.latest.title: Latest stored values
device.latest.description: The newest stored reading of each data point.
device.latest.description_since: The newest stored reading of each data point since {earliest}.
device.latest.failed: The latest values couldn't be loaded: {reason}
device.latest.empty_body: Nothing from this device has been stored since {earliest}. Check that gateway {gateway} is online and that the connection settings above are right. New readings show up here once they are stored; use Refresh to check again.
device.latest.no_points_title: This device has no data points
device.latest.no_points_body: The gateway reads only the data points of the device's model ({model}). Add data points to the model; their values show up here once readings are stored.
device.history.title: History
device.history.description: Stored readings of one data point, in your time zone ({zone}).
device.history.custom_hint: Times are in your time zone ({zone}); change it in your settings.
device.history.from_invalid: Enter the start date and time.
device.history.to_invalid: Enter the end date and time.
device.history.order_invalid: The end must be after the start.
device.history.no_points_body: The chart shows one data point of the device's model. Once the model has data points and readings are stored, choose one here.
device.history.outside_title: This range is outside the queryable period
device.history.outside_body: Stored history can be queried from {earliest} on, and the whole range you chose ({from} – {to}) is before that. Choose a more recent range.
device.history.truncated: The range starts before the queryable period, so the chart starts at {earliest}, the earliest data that can be queried.
device.history.empty_body: Nothing was stored for {point} between {from} and {to}. Choose a longer range, or check that the gateway is online and the device reports this data point.
device.history.text_only: {point} holds text, which can't be drawn as a chart. The table lists each interval's last reading.
device.history.chart_label: Chart of {point} from {from} to {to}. Use the arrow keys to read each interval.
device.history.hint: Point at the chart, or select it and use the arrow keys, to read an interval's values.
device.history.interval_note: Each point on the line is the mean over {interval}; the band shows the minimum and maximum.
device.history.interval_note_bool: Each point on the line is the share of readings that were on over {interval}.
